category_title: Gifted girls with ADHD prone to sensory distractibility and boredom with repetitive tasks
scenario_title: Repetitive homework assignments on mastered material
minimal_context: The student is at home working independently on a homework assignment covering previously learned material.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's get started on your homework assignment. You have these worksheets to complete.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I have so much energy right now, I feel like I'm gonna spaz out. I don't know what I would do without running first, because it tires me out but then I get home and I still can, like, function and do my homework.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We need to do the homework now. Please start on the first page.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: It's just the same material. We've been doing it years before, and I know it...

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just keep working through the problems until you finish the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I cannot focus on my homework. I don't... it's not that I don't like it, it's just that after a while I get bored and I don't want to do anymore after a certain point.
